sentence: This project tests whether vibrotactile stimulation to the larynx can reduce chronic cough that does not respond to standard treatments.
This project tries to find out which proteins interact with bestrophins, which are ion channels in the eye, and what those interactions do.
This project uses neural recordings and optogenetics to study how dentate spikes synchronize neural activity in the hippocampus and affect cognition in epilepsy.
This project tests whether combining two kinds of kinase inhibitors works better against pancreatic cancer in a mouse model.
This project builds a T cell therapy for solid tumors and uses single cell technologies to study how tumors respond to or resist treatment.
This project tries to find out how some cancers keep their telomeres long and which weaknesses those cancers have.
This project studies how the location of parts of signaling pathways inside cells controls signaling by the epidermal growth factor receptor.
This project screens compounds to find ones that reduce respiratory syncytial virus infection in infant bronchial epithelial cells.
This project creates mutant cell lines, images cell growth and division, and builds software to study how human cells divide.
This project provides shared instruments and imaging to help study how cancer-associated viruses replicate and cause human diseases.
This project provides microscopes that image living and fixed cells and tissues in detail for researchers studying digestive and liver disease.
This project looks for and tests biomarkers in plasma or urine that can tell the type and severity of pain in chronic pancreatitis.
This project tests targeted radiation followed by targeted immune therapy for solid tumors and studies the immune response before and after therapy.
This project uses a fluorescent reporter that senses glutamate to watch how neurons release neurotransmitters asynchronously at single synapses.
This project uses machine learning on screening videos of infants to predict autism diagnosis and severity from how they move.
This project studies how human genes relate to the bacteria and archaea on mucosal surfaces and how the microbiome affects gene expression.
This project runs cancer clinical trials and cancer care delivery research in community settings.
This project studies how genes and the environment interact to control gene expression and aging in a genetic model.
This project uses mouse models to study how mitochondrial DNA mutations build up and clear in different tissues and how they affect aging.
This project tests an active immunotherapy approach meant to protect against atherosclerosis or thrombosis in cardiovascular disease.
